## Approach

**Style match:** The project uses JUnit 3 exclusively (82 test files extend `junit.framework.TestCase`, 0 use `org.junit.Test`). The new class follows suit: `public final class ... extends TestCase`, `testXxx` methods, `try { ...; fail(); } catch (Expected expected) {}` idiom, explicit generic type arguments (no diamond — the module compiles at `-source 1.6`), Apache license header matching the sibling files in `com.google.gson.internal`.

**Public API covered** (`ConstructorConstructor(Map)`, `get(TypeToken)`, `toString()`, and the returned `ObjectConstructor.construct()`):

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| `toString()` | empty map → `"{}"`; reflects the *live* map reference after mutation |
| InstanceCreator resolution | exact-type match used & default ctor bypassed; exact preferred over raw-type; raw-type creator receives the full `ParameterizedType`; precedence over default constructor and over default collection impl; map consulted lazily on each `get` |
| Declared no-args constructor | public ctor body runs + fresh instances; private ctor invoked via `setAccessible`; ctor-thrown exception wrapped in `RuntimeException` with cause preserved; abstract class → `InstantiationException` cause; `String`→`""`; `Object` |
| Collection interface defaults | `Collection`/`List`→`ArrayList`, `Set`→`LinkedHashSet`, `SortedSet`/`NavigableSet`→`TreeSet`, `Queue`/`Deque`→`LinkedList`; constructed list is mutable |
| Map interface defaults | raw `Map` & `Map<String,_>`→`LinkedTreeMap`; `Map<Integer,_>`→`LinkedHashMap`; `SortedMap`/`NavigableMap`→`TreeMap`; `ConcurrentMap`→`ConcurrentHashMap`; `ConcurrentNavigableMap`→`ConcurrentSkipListMap` (the two `ConcurrentMap`/`ConcurrentNavigableMap` cases are this bug's regression scenarios); constructed map is mutable |
| `EnumSet` | parameterized → usable empty `EnumSet` (add/contains/size asserted); raw `EnumSet` → `JsonIOException` |
| Unsafe fallback | class with only an arg-taking constructor → allocated with constructor **and** field initializers bypassed (`value==null`, `number==0`); interface with no default impl → `RuntimeException` "Unable to invoke no-args constructor for" |
| Boundary | `get` never returns null (incl. `int.class`); null map → `NullPointerException` on `get` |

Assertions check returned runtime classes, emptiness/mutability, identity vs. freshness (`assertSame`/`assertNotSame`), recorded `Type` arguments, and exception messages/causes — not merely absence of exceptions. No files other than the test class were created or modified.
